brand_identity.name: VANTAGE HR
brand_identity.tagline: Orchestrate your workforce, don't just manage it.
brand_identity.description: A high-performance HR operating system that blends Swiss-style precision with AI-driven insights. It transforms mundane HR tasks into a command-center experience.
brand_identity.emotional_archetype: The Performance Pro (Elite Athleticism & Precision) + Swiss High-Contrast
brand_identity.visual_style: Glass Command Center: High-contrast data layers, localized glassmorphism for floating contexts, and kinetic accent colors.

design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Poster layouts with Sci-Fi HUD density.
Emotion First: HR is about people. Use warm tones for personal profiles, cool precision for data.
Content is King: Data isn't just rows; it's a story of performance.
Negative Space: Dense data needs breathing room. Use p-8 where others use p-4.
Contrast: Light Mode is Stark (Paper & Ink). Dark Mode is Deep (Obsidian & Neon).

rules: No 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Outfit' for that modern tech feel.
Overlines must be uppercase and tracking-widest.

bento_grid.wrapper: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)]

sidebar.style: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full border-r border-border bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-xl z-50

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-6 py-6 font-medium border border-border bg-transparent hover:bg-secondary transition-colors
buttons.ghost: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground text-sm font-medium
buttons.ai_action: bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 hover:shadow-indigo-500/40 transition-all

cards.default: rounded-xl border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300
cards.glass: rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xl
cards.interactive: cursor-pointer group relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

badges.status: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

charts.style: Clean, minimal axis lines, customized tooltips with glassmorphism. Use gradient fills for area charts.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain overlay (opacity 0.03) on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No full-screen gradients. Use 'mesh' gradients restricted to specific areas (e.g., behind a floating card).
visual_enhancers.ai_indicators: Use a subtle 'breathing' glow animation (box-shadow) for AI-generated insights or announcements.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use on the 'Smart Announcement' or 'Performance Review' cards to guide the user's eye.

images.description: Diverse group collaborating in modern office. Use for Landing Page Hero or 'About' section.
Professional ethnic woman. Use for User Profile mockups or Testimonials.
3D Neural Network. Use for 'Smart Insights' or 'AI Performance' background (with overlay).
Modern building architecture. Use for Login/Register page split background.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px (Light/Regular). Consistent size (w-5 h-5 for UI, w-8 h-8 for features).

smart_announcements.ui_pattern: Glassmorphic overlay or modal. Text streams in (typewriter effect).
smart_announcements.visual_cue: Sparkles icon (Lucide 'Sparkles') with a gradient text fill.

performance_insights.ui_pattern: Sidebar widget or Dashboard Hero Tile.
performance_insights.visual_cue: Animated progress bars or radar charts showing skills.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Theme Switcher' immediately in the Navbar.
For the 'Smart Announcement', mock the AI generation with a delay and a typewriter effect.
Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. DO NOT use grey blocks.
Prioritize the 'Bento Grid' layout for the main dashboard.
Ensure the 'Login' page uses the split layout: 50% Image (Architecture), 50% Form.
universal_guidelines: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Import 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' from Google Fonts.
Buttons must have interaction states (hover, active, focus).
Inputs must have a clear focus ring (ring-2 ring-primary).
Use 'gap-6' or 'gap-8' for grid layouts to let content breathe.
Charts must be accessible (use patterns or high contrast colors).
